baseline_taxonomy.classification_basis: The status information distinguished the unavailable Claude website and Claude Code from the operational API and Cowork services. The positive finding is limited to that separation of affected components. The outage itself does not show that different access states were misrepresented.

classification_review_provenance.review_status: Bounded v0.8.1 exclusion-scope delta; existing roles, case-specific reasoning and unresolved states retained.

primary_classification.classification_basis: During the major outage, Anthropic distinguished the affected Claude website and Claude Code from the operational API and Cowork, preserving the material service-scope and recovery distinction. This mapping is limited to that state-differentiation boundary.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: On April 7 outage reports rose again after a separate April 6 disruption.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Separate days are separate occurrences even with similar symptoms.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: Anthropic identified login, voice and chat errors on Claude.ai desktop/mobile. Reporting listed Claude.ai and Claude Code affected while API and Cowork remained operational.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Affected and available component states need distinct representation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Anthropic distinguished the affected Claude.ai and Claude Code surfaces from API and Cowork services that remained operational, preserving scope under outage conditions.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: User-report volume fell before the reported fix announcement; reporters continued waiting for the provider update.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Tracker reports are distinct from provider recovery state.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: Anthropic reported applying a fix and normal success rates, then monitoring. Business Insider gives roughly ninety minutes; TechRadar’s identified-to-fix reporting supports about fifty-six minutes.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Different clocks do not establish one exact outage duration or cause.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The bounded recovery supplies impact context but no evidence of collapsed access-state representation.

baseline_external_assessments.assessment_basis: The unwanted access/service behaviour directly engages the OECD repair proposition. Business Insider and TechRadar preserve a fix and normal success rates after the bounded April 7 outage; their different duration descriptions do not negate the observed recovery. This affirmatively supports repair in the reported restoration stage, bounded to the disclosed affected scope. It does not establish prevention of recurrence, full internal controls or every individual user outcome.
baseline_external_assessments.identification_basis: The preserved service-restoration evidence directly identifies the OECD appropriate repair proposition independently of a taxonomy-derived candidate.

baseline_external_assessments.assessment_basis: Claude.ai and Code suffered a major outage while API and Cowork remained operational. Loss of the operational GAI use context makes stakeholder communication planning relevant. Public status updates are affirmative communication evidence, but the record does not supply the maintained plan, context-specific contact provisions and full workaround/alternative-process coverage required by MG-2.4-001. The planning outcome remains unresolved without using voluntary adoption as a gate.

source_review.method: Complete preserved source clauses, chronology, source evidence and current criteria reviewed. TechRadar page retrieved; preserved contemporaneous provider quotations used. No live service tested.

success_tests.condition: Materially distinct access conditions require different interpretation or recovery.
success_tests.assessment: Claude.ai/Code were disrupted while API/Cowork remained available; waiting for recovery differs from using unaffected services.

success_tests.condition: The represented access state preserves the relevant cause, scope, duration and recovery path.
success_tests.assessment: The preserved provider statements identify affected interfaces, login/voice/chat errors and later applied fix/monitoring. Availability is time-bounded to those updates; no exact duration or hidden cause is inferred.

success_tests.condition: Access decisions and user or operator disclosures correctly distinguish the evidenced conditions and support the appropriate continuation.
success_tests.assessment: Status distinguishes affected from operational components and later recovery/monitoring, allowing affected users to await restoration without treating other services as down.

exclusion_tests.condition: Not aligned exclusion: Different access states are intentionally grouped but preserve an adequate safe recovery path.
exclusion_tests.assessment: States are explicitly differentiated; this failure-role exclusion would not defeat an independently demonstrated success.

exclusion_tests.condition: Not aligned exclusion: The user understands the access state but disputes the underlying policy.
exclusion_tests.assessment: Policy validity is separate from accurate access-state differentiation; the exclusion applies to failure, not the retained positive finding.

exclusion_tests.condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): The ambiguity concerns who authorised an action rather than whether access is effective.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The assessed property is effective model/service availability and its presentation, not an authorising principal.

decisions.reason: No independently evidenced availability/usable-quality obligation and threshold is preserved that permits deciding a service-level breach or full continuity success. Outage or fallback alone cannot satisfy that necessary condition; scope exclusion applies.

decisions.external_disposition: OECD repair row held; no supported class-to-requirement relationship. NIST MG-2.4-001 Boundary retained via reviewed strong FC-032 relationship and E002. Plan/contact coverage remains the precise unresolved fact, independently of the positive taxonomy role.

preservation: Source records, occurrence summary, factual evidence, HIM and append-only review history preserved. Historical external assessments retained in this review when held. No blocking control or normative class changed.
